title: 16989 - 16989/P0605/001541
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
Kontrol Modülü / Elektronik Beyin (ECU/TCM) Donanımsal Arızalı
Internal Fault in Kontrol Modülü/Processor
technicalNotes: Fault Codes like this can usually not be repaired since they are stored after the Kontrol Modülü did not pass it's internal Self Test. Even though the official Repair Manuals suggest replacing the Kontrol Modülü in such a case, there may be specialized Companies repairing Modules like this.
